title: selection
description: Plate selection for a bundle (selection.json): the density preset, its parameters, and the chosen plates with their lifecycle status. Updated additively across revisions (DESIGN §4.3, §8).

preset.description: Density preset that produced this selection (DESIGN §8).

params.description: Effective selection parameters (from the preset table, DESIGN §8).

min_gap.description: Minimum number of pages between kept plates.

max_gap.description: Maximum gap before a fill plate is sought within the window.

salience_floor.description: Minimum visual_salience [0,1] a fill candidate must clear to be selected.

chapter_open.description: Whether the first page of each chapter is a mandatory mark.

scene_boundary.description: Whether pages with scene_changed=true are mandatory marks.

plates.description: Selected plates in seq order. Only 'selected' plates flow to prompt derivation and render; 'retired' plates keep their files (additive invariant, DESIGN §4.4, §8).

page_id.description: Zero-padded 4-digit page id the plate illustrates. (Cover and portrait pseudo-plates are tracked in prompts/, not here.)

reason.description: Why the page was selected (DESIGN §8): a mandatory chapter opener, a scene boundary, a gap fill, or a manual override in review.

salience.description: Visual salience score [0,1] of the page at selection time.

status.description: Lifecycle of the plate: 'selected' (chosen, not yet approved), 'approved' (locked in review), 'rendered' (pixels exist), 'retired' (deselected in a later revision; files retained).

added_in_revision.description: Bundle revision in which this plate was first selected (DESIGN §8 re-selection).
